Contoso | Senior Software Engineer, Application Security | San Francisco, CA | ONSITE | $280K–$330K TC

Contoso is where communities spend time together, on desktop, mobile and inside third-party apps. That surface area and a large, sometimes adversarial user base make application security a hard and interesting problem.

We are hiring a Senior Application Security Engineer for the Product Security team. You will do threat modeling and design review, build AppSec tooling (SAST/DAST/dependency scanning) and work with engineering teams to fix findings.

Stack: Python mostly, some TypeScript/React. Runs on a major cloud.

Looking for: hands-on AppSec experience, comfort reviewing code in several languages and judgment about real risk.

Interview process: recruiter call, coding round, hiring manager interview, virtual onsite, decision.

Apply: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/contoso/jobs/1000001
